See evidence/variant-review/net.minecraft.world.level.gameevent.EuclideanGameEventListenerRegistry.visitInRangeListeners.diff.txt.

vanilla_game_event_registry_lookup.conversion: @Redirect on ChunkAccess.getListenerRegistry in GameEventDispatcher.post: the chunk's existing registry, or GameEventListenerRegistry.NOOP where LevelChunk would create an empty one (exact LevelChunk class only, otherwise the call itself; require = 0, degrades to vanilla; a Redirect because a WrapOperation's per-call Operation cost about what the lookup saves); a LevelChunk @Shadow accessor for its registry map (gameEventListenerRegistrySections), read only. 1.21.1: post and visitInRangeListeners take a Holder<GameEvent>; same section loop and registry code
vanilla_game_event_registry_lookup.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixins carry only our own logic (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_game_events.GameEventRegistries)

yields.name: Radium
yields.why: Radium 0.13.1's optional world.game_events.dispatch (off by default; Radium reads config/lithium.properties) @Redirects the same ChunkAccess.getListenerRegistry call in GameEventDispatcher.post (plus getChunkNow and visitInRangeListeners) to create section dispatchers only when a listener is added. Two redirects of one call cannot both apply; while that option is on our switch steps aside.
